findings.summary: Spreading openGraphBase (with images) silences file-based per-slug opengraph-image.tsx
Map<lower,userId> collision guard is iteration-order-dependent — last-write-wins can miss real collisions
Uses .filter() instead of .withIndex('userIdAndProvider') — Convex guideline violation
Unbounded ctx.db.query('users').collect() risks 8MB/4096-doc limit at scale
No account-level (provider, lower(providerAccountId)) collision pre-check
Missing recordError() per project convention
Zero-posts fallback uses today's date with no captureError — build-time content failure silent
aggregateRating comment claims '≥10 named reviews' as Google policy — SEO folklore, not Google's actual requirement
satisfies-vs-as-const rationale is misleading — override widening works with both
'build time' comment phrasing slightly imprecise — 'cached by default' is more accurate
aria-hidden defense-in-depth role (vs inert) not documented
'use client' + SSR interaction not explained — could confuse future maintainer
Mobile menu conditional-render is OK but asymmetry with desktop's DO-NOT-revert rule isn't documented
Auth-critical normalizeMixedCaseEmails — zero tests
Email normalization at line 77 is the migration's correctness anchor — untested
